facts.text: Norwood’s historic schoolhouse, built in 1896, now houses the Norwood Area Historical Society museum, showcasing local logging and maritime artifacts.
The town’s name comes from its location in the northern woods, a nod to the dense forests that once covered the area.
Norwood’s first post office opened on February 1, 1868, with William Harris serving as the inaugural postmaster.
In 1869, a frame schoolhouse was erected, and the current building was constructed in 1890, later serving as a church before becoming a school.
The Norwood Area Historical Society, founded in 1993, welcomes anyone interested in preserving the region’s history and hosts annual events like ice‑cream socials.
Norwood sits along Lake Michigan’s shoreline, making it a historic shipping hub since the early 1870s when a hotel opened nearby.
